prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Pet!", "Try Pet Controls", "Practice clicking, dragging, and calling your desktop companion before finishing setup.", "Try Pet Interaction"]
1: ["Choose Your Pet Journey", "Compare pre-made companions with fully custom pet creation.", "Select Companion Path"]
2: ["Create Custom Desktop Pet", "Follow step-by-step guidance to ensure high quality rendering for your desktop pet.", "Upload Source Photo", "Photo Lighting & Angle Verification"]
3: ["Sign In to Save Companion", "Keep Your Pet Safe", "Signing in ensures your pet's memory, items, and progress are synced safely to your cloud account.", "Cloud Sync Protection", "Continue to Sign In"]
4: ["Initializing Desktop Engine", "Preparing graphics engine, desktop overlay permissions, and pet assets.", "Desktop Overlay Status Active", "Engine Load Progress"]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Claim your starter badge and welcome your companion to your desktop!", "Starter Companion Badge Unlocked"]
6: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Discover interactive behaviors, custom animations, and instant desktop companionship.", "Interactive Desktop Behaviors", "Custom & Preset Pet Styles"]
7: ["Your Companion Is Active", "Quick Actions: Drag to move, right-click to hide, double-click to chat."]
8: ["Sign In to Desktop Pets", "Signing in secures your companion data across restarts and updates.", "Auto-Save Enabled", "Your pet progress and customization will automatically restore on sign-in."]
9: ["Select Your Desktop Companion", "Choose a pre-made pet personality to instantly summon to your desktop.", "Choose Companion"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requesting a source photo.
